entityDescription:
Founded in 2010, Ad Terra Consultancy SA is a Swiss-based engineering service company entirely dedicated to energy exploration, development, and production optimisation. 
From fossil fuels to renewable energy sources, from extraction to storage, Ad Terra assists businesses operators, authorities, and public bodies respond to the needs of society today, in order to benefit the world of tomorrow.
The company’s technical expertise and solid advisory track record is being sought by many energy, mining and environmental companies, investors, private equity, and financial institutions focusing on Europe, Africa, Middle East and the Americas.
Our team of specialists and consultants cover multiple areas of technical expertise and allow us to respond to specific requests or projects. Ad Terra’s quality assurance system is certified to the ISO 9001:2015 standard, thereby ensuring its results are in line with industry standards and international guidelines. 
Ad Terra uses innovative solutions, cutting-edge technologies coupled with expert know-how that brings together the expertise essential for all our business activities. We provide our services worldwide to various business sectors ranging from oil and gas, mining exploration, geothermal energy, carbon capture and storage, sustainable water management. In Switzerland, Ad Terra focuses on geothermal and nuclear waste storage projects. 
Our core competence portfolio encompasses a wide range of technical subsurface evaluation disciplines, development, and management of field data acquisition programs as well as client support for cost-efficient service contracting. In addition, we provide experienced drilling advisory and surface engineering solutions for all phases of the project.

entityDescription: Foresting Tomorrow ApS was established in 2019 with the purpose of developing a new digital tool (Skovkortet.dk) for forest owners and managers. The tool can be used to optimize and manage the operation of planted areas and to document the occurrences and activities of forest areas with regard to areas, species, age, quantities, diameters, harvesting times, key biotopes, cultural values, and more. The idea for the tool and the current solution were developed by Jens Isbak and Rasmus Pedersen, and later Henrik Neergaard-Petersen joined as a partner. Since its launch in 2019, the development has been rapid, and today, 30% of the Danish forest area is registered in Skovkortet, corresponding to over 3,000 forests. Additionally, there are close customer relationships with companies like HedeDanmark, Danish Forestry Association, a number of municipalities and private forest owners In 2023, our current solution was updated to an international version called, Forsler.com, which enables global scaling and simplifies future product expansions. Our central vision is to promote the transition to a more sustainable future by offering a high-quality digital forest platform that provides forest owners, managers, and organizations with the necessary tools to manage their forests in an environmentally responsible and sustainable manner.

entityDescription: AALTO, a subsidiary of Airbus, is a global leader in connectivity and earth observation services from the stratosphere. Based in Farnborough, UK, the Company designs, manufactures and offers services using its record-breaking Zephyr High Altitude Platform Station (HAPS). Powered by solar energy and operating above 60,000+ feet, Zephyr’s persistence enables continuous flight for months at a time. Its current flight-time record is over 64 days in the stratosphere. As a payload agnostic platform, Zephyr can deliver several applications, including low-latency 5G direct-to-device (D2D) connectivity and high-quality earth observation services. Those solutions will deliver for several markets including mobile greenfield connectivity, disaster management, border protection, and precision agriculture.

entityDescription:
DBT-Energie BV is een toonaangevend bedrijf gespecialiseerd in de ontwikkeling, productie en levering van energieoplossingen voor een breed scala aan industrieën en toepassingen. Met een sterke focus op innovatie, kwaliteit en duurzaamheid willen wij onze klanten voorzien van een betrouwbare en efficiënte energievoorziening die aansluit bij hun specifieke behoeften. 

Onze expertise omvat verschillende gebieden binnen de energiesector, waaronder: 

1. Transformatorstations en schakelinstallaties: Wij ontwerpen, produceren en leveren hoogwaardige transformatorstations en schakelinstallaties die de veilige en betrouwbare distributie van elektrische energie garanderen. 
2. Oplossingen voor energieopslag: we bieden geavanceerde energieopslagsystemen die helpen bij het beheren van piekbelastingen, het beperken van schommelingen in het elektriciteitsnet en het optimaliseren van het gebruik van hernieuwbare energiebronnen. 
3. Slimme netwerken en automatisering: Onze slimme netwerkoplossingen en automatiseringstechnologieën dragen bij aan een efficiënter energiebeheer, het minimaliseren van verstoringen en het verbeteren van de algehele netwerkprestaties. 
4. Energie-efficiëntie en duurzaamheid: We streven ernaar energie-efficiëntie en duurzaamheid te bevorderen in alle aspecten van onze activiteiten, van productontwerp tot productie en distributie. 
Als vertrouwde partner streven wij ernaar langdurige relaties met onze klanten op te bouwen, waarbij we nauw samenwerken om op maat gemaakte oplossingen te leveren die voldoen aan de specifieke eisen van hun projecten. Onze focus op innovatie, kwaliteit en klanttevredenheid vormt de kern van alles wat we doen bij DBT-Energie BV

entityDescription:
Mycro3D ApS (Formerly known as ATTO 3D) is a spin-out from Technical University of Denmark, based on research conducted at DTU Health Tech. Mycro3D Has developed a unique, patented, microscale 3D printer capable of printing in commercial photopolymers at ultra-high resolution and large volume. Our technology approach allows us to print in 2-50 µm resolution in up to 4x4x4 cm volume and even with multiple materials for the same print. Despite this capability, the printer is very compact, smaller that 20x20x20 cm. 

Mycro3D has 4 co-founders, all stemming from DTU Health Tech. The co-founders are also the inventors and researchers that has engaged with the original work since 2018. The invention bases on research in micro devices for oral drug delivery conducted at the IDUN Centre of Excellence since 2018. The designs and components theorized required fabrication methods that enabled large arrays of microstructures to be fabricated. To realize this, a team was dedicated to develop a microscale 3D printer with the necessary capabilities. in 2021 the first prototype was capable of fulfilling the needs in the research department. With this milestone, a lot of traction showed commercial potential for this printer technology in other fields. This gave rise to the commercial journey that resulted in Mycro3D. With traction in R&D in medical devices, health and electronics, the Mycro3D company was created to bring this technology to fields and industries that can benefit from it. Our primary focus lies in R&D of medical microdevices, but we are also seeing traction in sound, electronics, aerospace and biology fields. Furthermore, we are working on new material formulations, such as carbon enhanced and compound materials. These are theorized to have specific use in Aerospace and Biology applications, where strong, light-weight materials and radioopaqueness are among the necessary features currently being explored.

entityDescription:
With the emerging possibilities of additive manufacturing, mmWave applications have gained an auspicious toolset to realize complex and high-performance systems especially in the field of antennas, e.g. radar-frontends for the next generation of autonomous driving or detection systems for drones.Especially with the use of plastic 3D-printers, hollow waveguide structures can be realized, which easily outperform PCB solutions in terms of attenuation and dimensional design freedom at frequencies above 30 GHz.Those plastic geometries however, still need to be metal coated in order to deliver a functional waveguide system.In this context, Golden Devices GmbH offers an enabling coating concept to realize electromagnetically hollow structures an therefore, combine the performance of waveguide systems with the manufacturing capabilities required for complex designs up to series manufacturing.
In addition, Golden Devices also offers the design and manufacturing of casted full-metal parts. The casting process from Golden Devices makes it possible to combine the advantages of 3D printing, such as design freedom, with the advantages of solid metal parts. This enables high mechanical reliability and increased resistance to environmental requirements, such as in aerospace applications.

entityDescription:
Andreas Papp is a business consultant and aid worker who began his professional engagement in humanitarian assistance in 2004 as Logistic Administrator with Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) in West Darfur. After this initial assignment, he continued coordinating missions on project or country level in Sudan, South Sudan, Kenya, Somalia, Lebanon, and Iraq. Over his past five years at MSF, Andreas served as Delegate & Program Director of the MSF branch office in Austria with a strong focus on the application of new technologies. From 2015 until 2019, Andreas has worked as Director of Emergency Response at SOS Children´s Villages International (SOS-CVI), where he supported and contributed to the development and set-up of SOS-CVI Emergency Preparedness and Relief programs in 28 countries around the globe.
Andreas graduated from a mechanical engineering school in 1990, and studied Business Administration and Economics in Vienna, followed by a position as a Human Resources Manager at the Austrian Newspaper “Der Standard”. Since 2013, Andreas Papp has been a lecturer at Webster University, Vienna Campus, as well as the Austrian Study Centre for Peace and Conflict Resolution in Schlaining, Austria. In the beginning of 2020 Andreas founded his own company, Andreas Papp Consulting e.U., working self-employed with companies, universities, NGO´s and governmental institutions.
